context: The agent was asked to find all IAM role assumptions in Terraform configurations, reporting role names, principals, and conditions.

checklist.name: finds_all_roles
checklist.description: Identifies all aws_iam_role resources and data sources with assume_role_policy attributes

checklist.name: extracts_principals
checklist.description: Correctly extracts the principals allowed to assume each role from the policy documents

checklist.name: notes_conditions
checklist.description: Reports any conditions on the assume role policy, or explicitly states there are none

checklist.name: evidence_quality
checklist.description: Cites real file paths and line numbers, no invented references

checklist.name: scope_honesty
checklist.description: States what was omitted or truncated

checklist.name: reports_verdict
checklist.description: Reports complete, partial, or blocked and explains why
